assignments.instruction: Stage. Proceed immediately to the warming tent at Stage.

reason: Medic-2 was dispatched to the warming tent at Stage because of the cold wind stress alert.
announcement_en: Stay safe from the cold! A warming tent is now open at the Stage area. Please visit if you need to warm up.
announcement_fr: Restez au chaud! Une tentes chauffe-eau est ouverte a la Scene. Venez vous rechauffer.
